verdict.rationale: LM Studio serves a REST API and OpenAI-compatible endpoints, and can expose them on the network, so issuing API credentials is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack never documents API keys, tokens, or any scoped or least-privilege credential mechanism. The network-exposure toggle is an adjacent control, not credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
